items.title: Missiles worth $40 million a shot rack up US war costs in Iran
items.description: The cost of the US war in Iran continues to skyrocket with vast amounts of expensive high-end missile interceptors being used to defend against waves of cheap Iranian drones and ballistic missiles.

items.title: Record-smashing El Niño to deliver Australia a spring of droughts and fires
items.description: Despite El Niño being months away from peaking, it could potentially trigger Australia's hottest spring on record.

items.title: Labor warns One Nation terror laws would not survive High Court
items.description: Former home affairs secretary Mike Pezzullo said there is merit in a "compromise" approach to the current process of allowing temporarily excluded Australian citizens back into the country.

items.title: The major parties boycotted this UK by-election. Enter Count Binface
items.description: A novelty candidate called Count Binface will next month try and unseat one of the most prominent politicians in the Untied Kingdom when constituents in Clacton-on-Sea head the polls.

items.title: Chinese e-commerce site selling Australian police gear
items.description: Australian police uniforms and badges are being sold on a major Chinese online shopping platform as authorities warn of a growing wave of impersonation scams.

items.title: This woman sued for pregnancy discrimination and won. Her case is rare
items.description: Research shows pregnant women and new mothers are routinely let go from their jobs, discriminated against, and, in one case, forced to pump breastmilk in a storeroom. We want to hear your stories.

items.title: 'Her skin is bleeding': Devastating virus wreaks havoc in Gaza
items.description: As chickenpox spreads through Gaza's tent camps, the race to contain the virus is made harder by a lack of sanitation, overcrowding and summer heat.

items.title: Luxury cars and beach holidays luring mums into shampoo scheme
items.description: Sellers for a multi-level marketing company promise sisterhood, success and a more flexible life. But former insiders say the reality for most, is far from what’s being sold on social media.

items.title: Parents of Australian facing possible death penalty in Syria question confession
items.description: The family of a Gold Coast man who has been charged with murder over the death of an Australian in Syria is frustrated by the lack of progress made by the federal government in the case.

items.title: Live: Davies, Hull deliver barnburner finish in women's 5000m
items.description: Rose Davies has claimed a second gold medal of these Games, snatching gold in the women's 5000m from fellow Aussie Jess Hull, who claimed silver. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
